# Plotting in R

## Setting Environment

```{r ggplot for penguin data visualization}
library("tidyverse")
library("palmerpenguins")

```

##Beggining the first plot

```{r now plotting the data}
ggplot(data=penguins)+
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=flipper_length_mm,y=body_mass_g,color=species))+
  labs(title="Flipper LEngth vs Body Mass",caption="Data from 2007-2009")
```
